candidate_query:
MATCH (summary:Summary)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(:Company {companyName:'Huawei'}),
      (summary)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(agenda:AgendaItem),
      (summary)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(meeting:Meeting)
WHERE summary.summaryType='FL'
RETURN DISTINCT agenda.id AS agendaItemId, meeting.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt, agenda.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, agendaNumber ASC, agendaItemId ASC
